items.text: Fixed undergarments button not responding, restoring ability to change underwear via UI.
Fixed Rust+ pairing screen to allow attempts when no push‑enabled devices are present and show an error if the push fails.
Updated network panel and overlay to display proper units (kb, kb/s, ms, etc.) and adjusted layout so the panel fills from the top for clearer statistics.
Fixed a memory leak when closing the tattoo UI, prevented downed players from being kicked out, added the new artist stool item, and corrected tattoo persistence after server wipes when dead.
Stopped chat emoji videos from playing indefinitely after they finish.
Shrank the balloon platform, added a dedicated signal alarm with clearer volume and pitch, and enabled typing at the balloon console while its door opens.
Improved dog heel responsiveness and seek behavior, fixed sniffing bugs (dogs can now sniff sleeping bags, players, and corpses), and enhanced fetch mechanics for smoother companion interactions.
Refined free‑roam behavior by reducing exaggerated leaning, removing turning on the spot, and adding idle animations when dogs stop moving.
Bandit camp food vendor clipping fixed, restoring reliable interaction.
Fishing village vendor UI counters clipping resolved, improving information readability.
Bandit camp vendor UI counters clipping fixed, enhancing clarity of vendor data.
Raid window timer corrected, providing accurate countdowns for raid events.
DLSS startup hang fixed, preventing GPU freezes when launching with DLSS enabled.
Tattoo chairs now have functional colliders, restoring the ability to sit on them.

2026-11-25.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Recoil duration reduced by 75% on most weapons, making sustained fire feel more controllable.

### Movement & Controls
- Strafing now cancels sprint, and a crouch‑strafe bug has been fixed.
- Boat and cargo parenting bugs fixed: players no longer unintentionally transfer to cargo ships, exclusion zones prevent attachment to moving excavator arms, and ladder climbing from boats no longer drags players off.

### Building & Structures
- Gingerbread physics material added to low and half walls, affecting building physics for gingerbread structures.

### Trading & Crate System
- Tradable skin bundles now retain their tradeable status, fixing incorrect non‑tradable markings.
- Crate generators are now correctly recognized as bundles, ensuring proper operation within the bundle system.

### Tech Tree & UI
- Tech‑tree shuffled with a new in‑editor graph editor and reorganised tier 1‑3 trees for Hardcore and Primitive modes; UI now opens up to eight times faster, cutting load time from ~1.2 s to ~0.15 s.

### Boss & NPC Physics
- Scrap King’s physics material changed to metal, altering its interactions and damage handling.

### Customization
- New console variable lets players hide all tattoos

### Lighting & Visuals
- Brightness transition at dawn and dusk is smoother
- Night light now works correctly with the anti‑gamma fix
- Added foreground and background floor geometry for night shadows to prevent gamma spikes; includes a toggle convar

### Gameplay & Balance
- Sprint mechanics have been updated to the modern movement system, changing acceleration and stamina behavior for faster, smoother running.
